subject: [AMBER] Question about QM with Gaussian using GPU

messages.author: Ramdhan,Peter A
messages.body:
Hello,
I am looking to use GPUs for QM calculations on gaussian but I am unsure of how to add it through the gaussian interface of the sander input in amber. It seems there is only a place for CPUs. I am unsure if GPUs could be requested for the QM calculation while CPUs work for the sander portion. Any ideas?
